info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Retrieval API enables users to access and list detailed routes for rideshare rides. This endpoint provides essential data regarding the paths taken by vehicles, helping stakeholders gain insights into ride patterns and optimize transportation services. Typical consumers may include rideshare operators, logistics companies, and app developers looking to enhance user experience by integrating route information. Utilize this API to efficiently gather route data as part of your rideshare management or analysis operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the optimal route for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the optimal route for a specified ride, considering various factors such as traffic conditions, distance, and estimated time of arrival. It provides essential data that enhances the user experience by ensuring efficient ride planning.
